Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
April 13, 2010
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Pastor Matthew Palm, of Hope Church of the Nazarene
ROLL CALL
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.

P1.
Proclamation Congratulating the League of Women Voters North Coast San Diego County on their 90th Anniversary.
P2.
Proclamation declaring the May 8, 2010, "Mormon Helping Hands Day" in the City of Vista.
CONSENT CALENDAR

C2.

Traffic Signal Maintenance Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the City of San Marcos (CC)
DISCUSSION
D1.
City of Vista Crime Review (CC)
PUBLIC HEARING
PH1.
Downtown Specific Plan (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2010- , certifying the Final Program Environmental Impact Report for the Downtown Specific Plan, and adopting Environmental Findings and a Statement of Overriding Considerations pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act;
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2010- , approving a General Plan amendment to change the land use designation on 352 acres from Central Business District (CBD), Commercial Neighborhood (CN), General Commercial (GC), High Density Residential (HD), Medium High Density Residential (MHD), and Medium Low Density Residential (MLD) to Specific Plan Area (SPA), and change the land use designation on 4 acres from CBD to Medium Density Residential (MD); and
3.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2010- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Changing the Zoning from Specific Plan 26, Commercial (C-1 and C-2), Multi-Family Residential (R-M(15) and R-M(21)), and Residential (R-1) to Specific Plan Implementation (SPI) on 352 Acres, a Zone Change from Specific Plan 26 to Residential (R-1-B) on 4 Acres, Repeal of Specific Plan No. 26, and Adoption of the Downtown Specific Plan."
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.

R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
